caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug with a rounded body and a wide, slightly flaring mouth, featuring a small spout at the rim. The jug has one curved handle attached from the rim to the upper shoulder of the vessel. The body of the jug is mostly a warm, earthy, reddish-brown color with scattered darker brown, irregular blotches and patches. Near the shoulder of the jug, there is a horizontal, indented decorative band that circles around its circumference. The base is thickened and slightly uneven, rendered with lighter brown and grayish tones. The background is plain and light beige, without any distinct scenery or additional objects.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
